article.summary: A Python framework that transforms agent interaction events into curated memories, typed knowledge, identity, and token-budgeted prompt packs. This review records code evidence at one verified revision; no system behavior or performance was measured.

who_what.text: GitHub repository metadata identifies kaminocorp as the public organization that owns the canonical repository. The README presents Elephantasm as an open-source Python framework for long-term agentic memory; this review assesses its memory subsystem at the reviewed revision.
The project roster places Elephantasm at ordinal 212 and records the listed repository locator and Atlas roster attribution. Atlas is used only for identity/locator context, not assessment evidence.

architecture.text: PostgreSQL stores Animas, raw Events, Memories, typed Knowledge, identities, memory packs and audit/session records. Memories include content/summary, importance, confidence, lifecycle state, time range and optional pgvector embeddings; Knowledge has one of five epistemic types, confidence, source type, soft-delete state and optional embeddings.

The documented pipeline accumulates raw events, synthesizes them into structured memories after a configurable threshold, extracts typed knowledge, and supports Dreamer background curation. The MemoryEvent junction links memories to source events; knowledge audit rows can link derived knowledge to a source memory.

behavior.text: Write: event ingestion stores raw messages/tool/system events and can enqueue a threshold check when background jobs are enabled. Synthesis creates a Memory and its MemoryEvent provenance links in one RLS-scoped transaction. Embedding generation is best effort and may fail without failing memory persistence; knowledge extraction then writes typed items associated with the source memory.

Update/delete: memory operations permit partial updates, soft deletion and restoration; event routes provide updates and soft deletion; knowledge routes persist audit records for mutations. Soft-deleted rows remain stored. The inspected code does not establish complete erasure across all derived records, backups, embeddings and caches.

Retrieval: the compiler assembles identity, recent session memories, semantically retrieved knowledge, and scored long-term memories. It can embed a query, filters retrieval by anima/state/time/type/deletion status, and packages selected results with retrieval reason/score details. Query-aware pack requests compile fresh; a no-query path can return the latest stored pack. Source structure does not establish retrieval quality.

Provenance and trust: memory/event links preserve source event identifiers; knowledge audit records retain source memory identifiers and before/after state. Memory and knowledge confidence and lifecycle fields are present, but these are stored signals rather than externally adjudicated truth or evidence support. No citation-resolution or answer-grounding evaluation was performed.

Efficiency and observability: the compiler is synchronous, query retrieval uses an embedding provider, retrieval DTOs accept a maximum token budget, and synthesis/curation code logs activity and errors. Accumulation thresholds defer some synthesis work. These are source-visible mechanisms only; no latency, cost, token or storage measurements were collected.

metrics.evidence: Retrieval paths exist, but no answerable or unanswerable probe outputs were collected or adjudicated.
Memory updates and curation are implemented, but no correction history probes measured current-value or stale-value behavior.
Soft-delete paths are visible, but no post-delete probes or complete-erasure checks were run.
Anima filters and authenticated-user RLS context are present in source; no cross-user or cross-anima isolation probes were run.
Source lineage identifiers exist, but no generated claims or citations were collected and adjudicated for support or coverage.
No retrieval latency distribution was measured.
No scheduled post-write recall probes were run.
A pack token budget and synthesis bookkeeping are source-visible; no benchmark token usage or charges were recorded.
No benchmark-attributable storage byte measurements were collected.
Source contains synthesis metric helpers and persisted sessions/packs, but this review collected no runtime telemetry.

limits.text: This is a bounded read-only inspection of the official README and selected source files at the verified head. The system, tests, and benchmarks were not run; no runtime reliability, answer quality, authorization outcome, deletion completeness, resilience or performance claim is made.

RLS and per-anima filters provide source evidence of an intended boundary, not proof against deployment misconfiguration or adversarial access. External model/embedding provider behavior, production configuration, and full derived-data deletion were not assessed.

The official README was checked for a published contact email and none was found. The linked official website returned an expired TLS certificate during this check, so it could not be inspected; no email was inferred from commit or profile metadata.
